architecture: All three vehicles are loaded in every gameplay scene. One shared graph drives all three.

questions.title: Graph Shape
questions.prompt: Change the graph so all three vehicles speed up, move steadily, then stop inside the 30 m target.

questions.title: Area = Distance
questions.prompt: Adjust the graph so all three vehicles travel 60 m and stop exactly at their targets.

questions.title: Motion Puzzle
questions.prompt: Design one graph that makes all three vehicles pass the Speed Gate fast, move safely through the Slow Zone, and stop at 50 m.
